name: lint_python
description: Run ruff against the active Python tree (skipping _legacy/, vendor/, build output). Returns a normalised findings list — one entry per violation with {rule, severity, file, line, message}. Underlying engine: ruff (pip-installed).

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Subpath under Wylde/ to lint. Defaults to entire active tree.

parameters.name: select
parameters.description: Ruff rule selector (e.g. 'E,F,W' or 'ALL'). Defaults to ruff's own default set.
